description: Sweep findings share a semicolon-separated summary per project, before host reports. Preview retains awaiting tasks and reports lease expiry without writing; apply expires the tasks and removes them from in-progress. Preview timestamp ages are intentionally unpinned; exact apply output pins both project lines, note separators, and host-report ordering. The transcript is a single shared empty fleet listing.
